blockingFindings.description: Directly inspected current crouch and sit renders: exposed gray thigh/body surfaces break through the shorts at the inner thighs; the sit pose leaves skin visible to the hip crease. Current garment coverage and pose fit are rejected.
Directly inspected current back, crouch, and sit renders: rear overskirt forms an angular raised block and narrow pointed cloth tails under the seat. Silhouette and pose deformation remain rejected.

Directly inspected current front, side, arms-up, and arm-cross renders: repeated triangular faceting/shading remains across the sleeves, shoulders, side torso, and waist. Image evidence cannot isolate mesh versus normals.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
